title: Bedtime Routine: How to Create a Clear Mind Before Bed for Better Rest
description: A peaceful night starts with a simple routine that helps quiet racing thoughts and prepare your mind for sleep. Learn how to create a clear mind before bed using calming habits, evening reflection, mental decluttering, and relaxation techniques that reduce overthinking. This guide shares practical steps for building a restful bedtime routine, improving focus, and creating a calmer transition from busy days to peaceful nights. Save this approach to revisit when your mind feels overwhelmed. Save this pin for later.
